description: Defines the CatalogItem class representing a product in the catalog, including properties such as name, description, price, picture URI, type, and brand, along with methods to update these details.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Represents a catalog item with properties for name, description, price, picture URI, and links to type and brand entities. Provides methods to update its properties.

methods.name: CatalogItem
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new CatalogItem with specified type, brand, description, name, price, and picture URI.

methods.name: UpdateDetails
methods.description: Updates the catalog item's name, description, and price after validating input.

methods.name: UpdateBrand
methods.description: Updates the catalog item's brand ID, ensuring it is not zero.

methods.name: UpdateType
methods.description: Updates the catalog item's type ID, ensuring it is not zero.

methods.name: UpdatePictureUri
methods.description: Updates the picture URI, setting it to a formatted string with the picture name or clearing it if input is null or empty.

methods.name: CatalogItemDetails
methods.description: A record struct encapsulating the details of a catalog item for updates, including optional name and description, and a required price.
